summary.title: Suppress auto-applied bolus on very-low forecast
changes: The app now blocks automatically applied boluses when the glucose forecast predicts a very-low condition.
The forecast view now reflects when an auto-applied bolus was suppressed so forecast and dose match.
The low‑glucose warning can appear even if an auto-applied bolus was suppressed, and confirmations only prompt for real.
Recalculations are protected from stale results so forecasts and insulin recommendations stay in sync after input or UI.
